title: Release app to Chrome Web Store
summary:
Files reorganized under `docs/`: `privacy-meridian.md`, `release-validation.md`, `store-listing.md`. All cross-references updated, nothing committed yet. Privacy policy deploying now.

Release pipeline remaining steps:
1. **Build & hash-verify ZIP** — zip `meridian-extension/`, confirm matches validated hash (`5702e8ce…`) from release-validation.md before upload. Ready to have Coder do this.
2. **Chrome Web Store (manual)**:
   - Upload ZIP
   - Paste listing copy, summary, description, category from store-listing.md
   - Privacy practices tab: single-purpose description, data-type checkboxes (per store-listing.md §2.2), affirm three certifications, enter privacy policy URL
   - Per-permission justifications from store-listing.md §4
   - Upload store assets (promo tile; verify store-assets/README.md for others)
3. **Submit for review.**

User now working on privacy URL deployment. Awaiting go-ahead on step 1 (ZIP build/hash).
